name: deploys
definition: Indicates that an organization sets up, runs, or operates an instance of a software system or platform.

name: part-of
definition: Indicates that an entity is a structural division, subunit, or member of another organization.

name: uses-email
definition: Indicates that an organization or individual uses a specific email address as a point of contact.

name: uses
definition: Indicates that a threat actor employs a specific malware, tool, or infrastructure.

name: targets
definition: Indicates that a threat actor directs malicious activities against a country, sector, or organization.

name: delivers
definition: Indicates that a file, email, or process drops, extracts, or transmits another payload.

name: exfiltrates-to
definition: Indicates that a malware transmits stolen data to a remote address or domain.

name: hosted-on
definition: Indicates that an internet resource or domain is hosted or deployed on a specific service platform.

name: exploits
definition: Indicates that a malicious file, tool, or threat actor leverages a software vulnerability to execute code or gain access.
